method: Installed MV3 extension in isolated Chromium. Neutral page text uses local projected brightness, including bloom and direction flags. Controlled title and metadata tests mask glyph visibility for blank PNG regions, check dark/light backgrounds, paused scroll, brand colors, forced themes and restoration. A separate regression counts paused inspection requests and verifies subsequent idle rendering. Public Bilibili comparison keeps the same paused media frame, clears regional ink, waits 400 ms for native title color transitions, restores regional records, and disables glyph transitions and animations before measuring a transparent-glyph PNG. Computed transparency is verified for every sample.
limits: Contrast covers the recorded line regions and media frame, not every text position or frame. Callback cadence and software GPU probes do not measure physical screen latency. Earlier observations use other frames and browser loads.
